title_zh: InferenceEvolve：通过自进化AI自动发现因果效应估计器
one_line: OpenEvolve/MAP-Elites evolves causal-effect estimator programs with LLM mutation, scored on training replicates (ground-truth or proxy objectives), evaluated on held-out replicates.
one_line_zh: 基于OpenEvolve与MAP-Elites用LLM变异进化因果效应估计器程序，在训练副本上以真值或代理目标评分，在留出副本上评测。

held_out.quote: Search-time scoring is always computed on the training replicates only; the final archived best program is then evaluated once on the untouched validation replicates, and only these held-out metrics appear in the main text.

leakage_guard.quote: Search received feedback only from the training replicates, whereas every quantitative claim in the main text is evaluated on the untouched held-out replicates.

evidence_level.quote: Search-time scoring is always computed on the training replicates only; the final archived best program is then evaluated once on the untouched validation replicates, and only these held-out metrics appear in the main text.

S1.quote: InferenceEvolve builds on OpenEvolve ( Sharma, 2025 ) , an implementation of evolutionary program synthesis that uses MAP-Elites ( Mouret and Clune, 2015 ) to preserve both high-performing and diverse solutions.

S2.quote: the standard evaluation paradigm in causal inference already relies on simulated datasets with known ground truth, providing a natural fitness signal for optimization.

F1.quote: InferenceEvolve builds on OpenEvolve ( Sharma, 2025 ) , an implementation of evolutionary program synthesis that uses MAP-Elites ( Mouret and Clune, 2015 ) to preserve both high-performing and diverse solutions.

title_zh: RoboPhD：在紧评测预算下进化多样复杂智能体
one_line: Evolves agent code with Claude Code using validation-free Elo tournaments on fresh training samples, comparative error reports and self-instrumenting print diagnostics, versus GEPA and Autoresearch at 1,500 evaluations.
one_line_zh: 用Claude Code进化智能体代码，以无验证集的Elo锦标赛、对比错误报告和自插桩诊断驱动，在1500次评测预算下对比GEPA与Autoresearch。

held_out.quote: These are separate sets from a held-out test set, which is never used in the optimization process itself so as to have a better estimate of performance on future, unseen cases.

improver_comparison.quote: All experiments here use a single, deliberately simple strategy (“use your judgment”; Appendix C ), leaving meta-evolution for future work.

code.quote: We release RoboPhD as a versatile toolkit under the MIT license with a simple optimize_anything() API for evolving diverse complex agents.

evidence_level.quote: These are separate sets from a held-out test set, which is never used in the optimization process itself so as to have a better estimate of performance on future, unseen cases.

S1.quote: RoboPhD introduces validation-free evolution: instead of splitting the budget between training and validation, it uses Elo competition on training data to simultaneously evaluate agents and drive evolution.

S2.quote: Scoring uses BIRD’s set-based execution accuracy.

title_zh: Autopoiesis：运行时动态下LLM服务的自进化系统范式
one_line: Continuously rewrites LLM-serving scheduling policy code via LLM-driven evolutionary program synthesis on snapshotted runtime traces, deploying superior policies to the live data plane.
one_line_zh: 在服务过程中基于运行时轨迹快照，用LLM驱动的进化程序合成持续重写调度策略代码，并将更优策略部署到数据面。

evidence_level.quote: We evaluate Autopoiesis across diverse runtime dynamics and show up to 53% and on average 34% improvements over state-of-the-art LLM serving systems.

S1.quote: In this work, we bring this synthesis capability to LLM serving, utilizing it to continuously explore and navigate the multi-dimensional trade-off space

F1.quote: In this work, we bring this synthesis capability to LLM serving, utilizing it to continuously explore and navigate the multi-dimensional trade-off space

title_zh: SkillMOO：面向软件工程的智能体技能多目标优化

title_zh: EDA工具的自主进化：多智能体自进化ABC
one_line: Planner plus three subsystem coding agents iteratively rewrite ABC's C code, gated by compilation and equivalence checking, retaining changes that improve QoR on benchmark suites.
one_line_zh: 规划智能体与三个子系统编码智能体迭代改写ABC的C代码，经编译与等价性检查把关，保留在基准上提升QoR的改动。

held_out.quote: For each cycle, the evolved ABC version is evaluated on eight synthesis flows using the ASAP7 7 nm library, covering the full logic optimization, mapping, buffering, gate sizing, and static timing analysis stages.

optimizer_cost.quote: The total token cost of the full system is approximately $2,400.

retained_ablation.quote: Table 2 summarizes the averaged quality of results for all combinations of evolved and vanilla subsystems, normalized to the baseline configuration

evidence_level.quote: Beneficial changes are retained and accumulated over many generations

S2.quote: Because full-design equivalence checking prevents faulty versions from progressing to evaluation, more than 90% of tokens are spent on semantically valid code states

S4.quote: it interprets the QoR feedback from previous cycles, aggregates hypotheses and change proposals from each coding agent, and determines which subsystem should be evolved next.

F1.quote: This paper introduces the first \emph{self-evolving} logic synthesis framework, which leverages Large Language Model (LLM) agents to autonomously improve the source code of \textsc{ABC}

F5.quote: Rather than relying on a single monolithic agent attempting to modify the entire ABC codebase, our framework employs multiple specialized agents, each responsible for a well-scoped subsystem.

title_zh: EvoMaster：面向规模化智能体科学的基础进化智能体框架

one_line_zh: 通用智能体框架，含执行、探索、进化三层嵌套循环：研究内按证据选择候选，跨研究蒸馏并累积技能、提示和记忆。
